lines.line: In training, Stack Overflow fires blocks from the top of its stack.
Its whip lashes out low, and holding up sends it straight up.
Its beam fires all five blocks at once.
A parry to the side stops a rod, and an overhead parry stops ChatGPT's slab.
Crouching lets Claude's fling pass overhead, and a double tap dashes past.
With no jumps left below the stage, the upward whip grabs the ledge and pulls it back up.
